t: A free browser tool for building games and simulations with blocks.
steps: Read the privacy policy before students sign in. Research could not read it in full.
Check with the vendor whether accounts are required. The research did not confirm this.
Register or log in on one teacher computer and create a test project.
Look through the public gallery and choose a model to demonstrate.
Decide whether students will share projects publicly.
Have students log in and build a first simulation.
